name: summon-human
description: Lets an agent ask frond-alarm to phone figs, the Thornfield frond's human, and read what happened. A skill gives the one command for "I want figs here now", how to word the call, and the room @-mention for what can wait. A standard-library script files one request in the alarm's own format, with up to three questions for figs, and reads the outcome and figs's answers from what its worker wrote. The only credential is your GitHub token, and the alarm accepts only the callers it lists.
